propos: One family: a 24 grid, 2 px stroke, round caps and joins, no fill except the dot in “Under way”.
regle: An icon never informs on its own: the word beside it carries the meaning. Only the tab bar places it above its label. Colour is inherited from the text.
famille-propos: The name is written without the sprite prefix. These are technical identifiers: they are not translated.
tailles-propos: The same symbol at the six permitted sizes. No other exists.
couleur-propos: An icon takes the colour of the text around it: the parent decides, never the symbol.
